title: COS 101 ( UNINIGER ) : INTRODUCTION TO COMPUTING SCIENCE
subject: COS 101

questions.question: What does information processing primarily involve?
questions.explanation: Information processing involves the acquisition, recording, organization, and retrieval of information.

questions.question: A computer information processor processes information to produce what?
questions.explanation: A computer information processor processes information to produce understandable results.

questions.question: Which activity is part of information processing?
questions.explanation: Processing may include acquisition, recording, assembly, retrieval, or dissemination of information.

questions.question: In printing a text file, the processor works to do what?
questions.explanation: The processor translates and formats digital information for printed form.

questions.question: The term information processing is applied to which operations?
questions.explanation: The term information processing is applied to computer-based operations.

questions.question: Digitalized information is manipulated by which machine?
questions.explanation: Digitalized information is manipulated by a digital electronic machine such as a computer.

questions.question: Which is part of the information processing system?
questions.explanation: The information processing system includes business software, computers, operating systems, mainframes, and networks.

questions.question: Which characteristic ensures information has a direct impact on decision-making?
questions.explanation: Accurate information has a direct impact on the decision-making process.

questions.question: Why is timeliness important in information processing?
questions.explanation: A delay in obtaining information can make it useless.

questions.question: What can incomplete data and information lead to?
questions.explanation: Incomplete data and information can lead to incorrect results.

questions.question: Which characteristic states that information has no meaning until it is finished?
questions.explanation: Completeness means information has no meaning until it is finished.

questions.question: Information that is not comprehensive is considered what?
questions.explanation: Only comprehensive information is useful; otherwise it is considered useless.

questions.question: How many types of information processing are identified?
questions.explanation: There are two types of information processing.

questions.question: Which is a type of information processing?
questions.explanation: Vertical and horizontal information processing are the two types.

questions.question: Information processing can be centralized or what?
questions.explanation: Information processing can be either decentralized or centralized.

questions.question: The information processing concept is based on how many assumptions?
questions.explanation: The information processing concept is based on several assumptions.

questions.question: Which units process available information?
questions.explanation: Available information is processed by short-term memory, perception, and attention.

questions.question: What does the processing system do with collected information?
questions.explanation: The processing system alters or transfers collected information systematically.

questions.question: Information processing aims to offer details about what?
questions.explanation: It aims to offer details about the structure and processes that motivate performance.

questions.question: Information processing in human beings resembles that of what?
questions.explanation: Information processing in human beings greatly resembles that of computers.

questions.question: Which is a step in information processing?
questions.explanation: The steps include input processing, data processing, output processing, and storage processing.

questions.question: Which step involves data processing?
questions.explanation: Data processing is one of the four steps in information processing.

questions.question: Which step comes after data processing?
questions.explanation: Output processing follows data processing in the sequence.

questions.question: Storage processing is which step?
questions.explanation: Storage processing is listed as the fourth step.

questions.question: Which tool retrieves required data from databases?
questions.explanation: A search engine is an information processing tool that retrieves required data from databases.

questions.question: Which tool provides statistical reports and financial accounts?
questions.explanation: The server provides statistical reports and financial accounts to help decision-making.

questions.question: Geographic information systems do what?
questions.explanation: GIS includes software and hardware that retrieve, analyze, manage, and store geographic information.

questions.question: Enterprise systems use what to integrate stored data?
questions.explanation: Enterprise systems use identifiers to integrate stored data from one system to another.

questions.question: Which is a tool used in information processing?
questions.explanation: Database is listed among the tools used in information processing.

questions.question: When a computer must react within a guaranteed time, which system is used?
questions.explanation: A real-time operating system is used when the computer must react within a guaranteed time.

questions.question: Which mode allows several programs to appear to run at once?
questions.explanation: Multi-programming is a method where several programs appear to be running at once.

questions.question: In which mode are programs or data collected and processed in one go?
questions.explanation: Batch processing collects programs or data in a batch and processes them in one go.

questions.question: Which mode requires continual exchange between user and computer?
questions.explanation: Interactive processing requires continual exchange of information between user and computer.

questions.question: What does multi-tasking allow multiple tasks to do?
questions.explanation: Multi-tasking allows multiple tasks to run concurrently, taking turns using resources.

questions.question: A multi-access system allows several users to use the same system via what?
questions.explanation: A multi-access system allows several users to use the same system together via a LAN.

questions.question: The engine management system in a car uses which operating system?
questions.explanation: The engine management system uses a real-time operating system to react to sensor feedback.

questions.question: Informational Processing talks about how many types of processing?
questions.explanation: Informational Processing talks about three different types of processing.

questions.question: Which is a type of informational processing?
questions.explanation: The three types are visual, acoustic, and semantic.

questions.question: With visual processing, you process things such as what?
questions.explanation: Visual processing involves processing things such as pictures or visual memories.

questions.question: Which type of informational processing deals with sounds?
questions.explanation: Acoustic processing deals with sounds.

questions.question: Semantic processing relates to what?
questions.explanation: Semantic processing relates to meaning.

questions.question: Information processing has become very important in which world?
questions.explanation: Information processing has become very important in the business world.

questions.question: Information processing has helped organizations improve what?
questions.explanation: It has helped improve productivity and output.

questions.question: Which is a way information processing helps society?
questions.explanation: Information processing helps through communication, inventory management, MIS, and CRM.

questions.question: Customer Relationship Management is an example of what?
questions.explanation: CRM is listed as a way information processing helps society.

questions.question: Management Information Systems help organizations do what?
questions.explanation: MIS helps organizations in more efficient management.

questions.question: Information technology provides what benefits to the business world?
questions.explanation: IT allows organizations to work more efficiently and maximize productivity.

questions.question: Which is an advantage of information technology in business?
questions.explanation: Storing and protecting information is listed as an advantage.

questions.question: Working away from the office, such as working from home, is an advantage known as what?
questions.explanation: Working away, such as working from home, is listed as an advantage.

questions.question: Automated processes are an advantage of information technology in what area?
questions.explanation: Automated processes are listed among the advantages of IT in business.
